candidates.change_summary: Replace the selfdestruct target from payable(msg.sender) to payable(address(0)) so that funds go to the zero address instead of the caller.
Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any caller to invoke the guarded function.
Replace selfdestruct with a no-op (empty block) so that the contract does not self-destruct, leaving its existence and state unchanged.
